insights.head: No Critical risks; 2 High
insights.body: Change reaches production without approval, and External data breach through an over-privileged tool.

insights.head: What drives the High ratings
insights.body: Likelihood: many releases (RD22) with a release process that varies by repo (RD45) and partly kept documentation (RD35). Impact: a regulated process (RD43) that moves money (RD50).

insights.head: Pervasive: Access to confidential data (RD01)
insights.body: On in 3 of 4 categories (Cyber, Data and, through the data it touches, Change). It is behind 3 of the 7 risks that apply.

insights.head: Pervasive: Many releases (RD22)
insights.body: From TRUST data, not the questionnaire: 41 releases in October, above most teams. It reaches Change and Operations.
